notes: Corrects the remaining iPhone Daily Operations scroll jitter. The prior v3.5.23 release identified the page-wide protected-context MutationObserver as the cause, but the observer was still being installed in Daily Operations. v3.5.24 now actually suppresses that observer only while protected-context initializes on the Daily Operations page, then immediately restores the browser's native MutationObserver for the rest of the app. Vault session-change/pageshow/visibility refreshes remain available, and no Vault records, checklist items, or protected values are modified. Daily and root offline caches were bumped.
name: TEE v3.5.24 — Daily Operations Scroll Stability Correction
